briefing: Markets were essentially flat today (NASDAQ +0.1%, S&P500 +0.3%), a neutral session with no clear directional conviction. Top candidates show bullish RSI/MACD setups but lack the volume-surge confirmation that past reviews flagged as necessary for high-conviction buys, so we're holding cash and existing positions rather than forcing a trade.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Risk-off doesn't always mean a market crash — sometimes it simply means staying cautious when signals are mixed or incomplete, like today when candidates showed bullish momentum but lacked volume confirmation. Holding cash and existing winners through a neutral day protects capital for when a clearer opportunity appears.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」（Risk-Off）不一定代表市場暴跌，有時只是在訊號不完整或混亂時保持謹慎——例如今日候選股雖有看漲動能，卻缺乏成交量確認。在普通交易日持有現金及現有強勢持股，是為了在更明確的機會出現時保留資本。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted sideways today with the NASDAQ up just 0.1% and the S&P 500 up 0.3%, reflecting a lack of strong catalysts in either direction. Without major economic data releases or earnings surprises driving flows, traders stayed largely on the sidelines. This kind of low-volatility, range-bound session often precedes a bigger directional move once new information arrives.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市窄幅上落，納斯達克僅升0.1%，標普500升0.3%，反映市場缺乏明顯方向性催化劑。由於沒有重大經濟數據或盈利意外刺激資金流向，投資者大多選擇觀望。這種低波動、區間徘徊的交易日往往是醞釀下一輪較大方向性走勢的前奏。
